ios.desc:
Albums are complete works of art. The cover, the sequence, the stories between the tracks — they were designed to be experienced together, not shuffled into a mood playlist. Great records deserve more than a thumbnail.

Wax is Apple Music for people who miss record stores. Big covers, no clutter, real stories.

THE CRATE
A personal collection you flip through like a box of records. Every spine, every cover, arranged the way you'd arrange them at home. Sign in with Apple to keep your crate in sync across iPhone and iPad. Share crates with friends and discover what's in theirs.

THE GATEFOLD
Open an album and read the liner notes streaming forgot. Apple Music editorial — always free. Tap the sparkles to dig deeper: AI-generated stories about the making of the record, plus the musicians, producers, and engineers behind every track.

THE VINYL
Play a record and watch it spin. Picture-disc artwork in the grooves, light catching the surface as it turns. Not a gimmick — a reminder that music is physical, even when it isn't.

WAX RECOMMENDS
Tap the sparkles on the Discover tab and let Wax point you to the deep cuts — albums in the same orbit, with a short note on why each one fits.

WAXAI CREDITS
WaxAI powers album stories, track facts, and Wax Recommends. Credits are how you pay for it — no subscription, no surprises. Tap a sparkles button to spend one. Packs start from 10. Signing in includes a starting balance.

UNLIMITED CRATE
A one-time purchase that lifts the free-tier album cap. Grow your collection as big as your taste. Includes bonus WaxAI credits.

Built with love by a lifelong lover of great music.

Requires an active Apple Music subscription.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Wax Crate – Browse your Apple Music library like a crate of records

quotes.text:
Hello HN, long time lurker, probably first time poster

I made an app that lets you browse your Apple Music library as a crate of records. (Sorry Spotify users, - I tried, but Spotify seem to be oddly developer hostile :( )

Been a vinyl collector for years and always felt like streaming apps 'playlist everything!' kill the "intentionality" of listening to records. So I built something.

Wax Crate lets you browse your Apple Music library as physical crates — big covers, no shuffle, no algorithm. When you play something, you get a spinning picture-disc visualisation with the artwork embedded in the grooves.

There are also pre-made crates to browse straight away - hundreds of classic albums, plus curated label catalogues from Verve, Blue Note, Prestige and more — whatever's available on Apple Music, with more labels coming over time. Great for discovering what you should have in your collection.

If you want to go deeper, there's an optional subscription ($3.99/month) that uses AI to pull together track-by-track production notes and behind-the-scenes factoids — the kind of stuff that used to live in liner notes. I charge for it because the AI costs aren't nothing. But the app is completely solid without it.

It's free to try. Launch offer: use code FIRSTIN to get unlimited crates at a discount — redeem here: https://apps.apple.com/redeem/?ctx=offercodes&id=6760627334&code=FIRSTIN

Would genuinely love feedback from people who actually care about albums as complete works.
